69- Chapters as a grid of numbers (tiles per row)

You can mix these with normal words in the library search:

chapters>50, unread>=10, read<5, bookmarks>0, downloaded>0
chapters:10-50 (between)
added>2025-01-01, updated<2025-06-01, lastread>2025-03-01
tag:romance (has the tag)
-tag:horror (does not have it)
anytag:romance,comedy (has any of them)
notags (no tags at all)
source:mangadex (source name)

Example: tag:romance unread>0 chapters>20
